incidents.title: Payment error-rate regression after deployment
incidents.alert_summary: HTTP 500 rate increased from 0.4% to 18% immediately after deployment v2.4.1.

trace.label: Triaged alert and created evidence plan

evidence.summary: ERROR: provider configuration missing required merchant_account_id
v2.4.1 deployed 20 minutes before the alert; provider configuration loader changed
Payment rollback procedure requires human authorization and post-rollback health checks

report.issue_summary: Payment authorization failures began immediately after release v2.4.1.
report.probable_root_cause: Release v2.4.1 introduced an invalid payment-provider configuration key.
report.suggested_fix: Restore the previous configuration and verify payment authorization health.
report.rollback_recommendation: Recommend rollback to v2.4.0 after incident-commander approval.
report.prevention_action: Add deployment-time configuration schema validation and a payment canary.

incidents.title: Notification Kafka consumer lag
incidents.alert_summary: Consumer lag grew above 18,000 messages while processing throughput collapsed.

evidence.summary: ERROR: deserialization failure; offset not committed; retry budget exhausted
Quarantine poison events before restarting the consumer

report.issue_summary: Notification consumption stalled while lag increased.
report.probable_root_cause: Poison messages repeatedly failed deserialization and prevented offset progress.
report.suggested_fix: Quarantine the poison message, repair schema handling, and restart the consumer after review.
report.rollback_recommendation: No rollback unless the schema handler changed in the latest release.
report.prevention_action: Add a dead-letter topic and schema compatibility tests.

incidents.title: Checkout API timeout
incidents.alert_summary: p95 latency increased from 240 ms to 8.4 s and checkout requests timed out.

evidence.summary: ERROR: upstream inventory reservation exceeded 8000ms deadline
Restore dependency latency before increasing timeout budgets

report.issue_summary: Inventory reservations exceeded the checkout timeout budget.
report.probable_root_cause: A slow inventory dependency exhausted the upstream request timeout budget.
report.suggested_fix: Reduce traffic pressure and restore inventory latency before tuning timeout budgets.
report.rollback_recommendation: Rollback only if deployment evidence establishes temporal correlation.
report.prevention_action: Add dependency latency SLOs, circuit breaking, and timeout-budget tests.

incidents.title: Order database connection exhaustion
incidents.alert_summary: Available database connections reached zero and order latency spiked.

evidence.summary: ERROR: QueuePool limit reached; connection timed out after 30 seconds
Available order database connections reached zero
Shed load and identify leaked transactions before changing pool limits

report.issue_summary: Order requests stalled when the database pool exhausted.
report.probable_root_cause: A leaked transaction path exhausted the order-service connection pool.
report.suggested_fix: Stop the leaking path, shed load, and restore pool capacity.
report.rollback_recommendation: Recommend rollback only after confirming the leak began with a release.
report.prevention_action: Add transaction leak tests and pool saturation alerts.

incidents.title: Authentication API failure
incidents.alert_summary: Valid users received HTTP 401 responses across protected endpoints.

evidence.summary: ERROR: JWT signature verification failed: active key id not found
Authentication success rate fell across protected endpoints
Restore the active signing key and validate key rotation

report.issue_summary: Valid access tokens were rejected by the gateway.
report.probable_root_cause: An expired signing-key configuration removed the active token-validation key.
report.suggested_fix: Restore the active signing key and validate token rotation after review.
report.rollback_recommendation: No application rollback is indicated by the retrieved evidence.
report.prevention_action: Alert before key expiry and test overlapping rotation windows.
